static.docstringItem5:
묶음 출처 일치: 문항이 살피는 문서 가운데 문서 목록의 묶음 번호(`tdoc:tsgCRPack`)가 묶음 기록의 소속과 다른
   문서가 없다. 두 출처가 갈리는 문서는 어느 쪽을 읽느냐에 따라 답이 달라지므로 정답을 하나로 정할 수 없다.

considered.revision_chain: WITH RECURSIVE later(id) AS ( SELECT later FROM revision WHERE earlier = :anchor UNION SELECT r.later FROM revision r JOIN later l ON r.earlier = l.id) SELECT id FROM later
considered.clause_history: SELECT s.cr FROM section_change s JOIN doc ON doc.id = s.cr WHERE s.section = :anchor AND doc.release = s.release
considered.pack_origin: SELECT cr FROM pack_member WHERE pack_id = :anchor UNION SELECT id FROM doc WHERE pack_field = :anchor_local

lostRowDirections.meaning: 바뀐 문항의 읽은 문서 가운데 기록 묶음과 목록 값이 다른 문서를 방향별로 나누고, 그 방향의 문서에만 기록 행을 되돌렸을 때 되찾는 손실 행을 센다

passages.needle: remove items that admit two answers
passages.text:
the disposition code behind every empty gold answer. Two further conditions
remove items that admit two answers. Pack membership is stated by the pack records and by the secretariat list
(Section~\ref{sec:linkaudit}); each pack the list names for a consulted
document must list it as a member. A revised change request keeps its CR number under
a new document number, so the gate also rejects an item when another document
with the same specification and CR number lies in a pack outside the gold.
The gate rejects 3 of the 670 drawn items, two under the first condition, one
under the second.
